# falljurisdiction

> Does this document cite the law of a country it does not claim to be from? 11 of 23 US forks still cite UK-only law. Mutation-gated.

falljurisdiction is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
